modules.name: comment
modules.text:
You can add sub-patches to your patches. These are like subroutines and can have inputs and outputs

To Do:
* Add a "patch" module between the fader and the lineOut. (Use the Filter box if needed.)
* Double click on the patch header to open the patch editor. Move the window out of the way so you can see this comment.

* Add a core "input" module on the left side of the patch.
* Add a ksyn "aOutput" module on the left side of the patch.
* Note that the top level "patch" module now has jacks with the same names.
* Add a sineOsc in the middle of the patch.

* Connect the in1 to the sineOsc frequency.
* Connect the sineOsc output to the aOut1 input.
* Turn the volume down on your audio system.
* In the top root patch, connect the fader and the lineOut to your new patch.
* Turn up the volume and move the fader.
